method: fresh shallow clone of the pinned commit; classified first (access method, demand signal, retry and pacing, failure, plumbing), then compared with ECDEV

coverage.statement: Bounded semantic review of the files named, not the whole source. No extinction is claimed.

rows.behaviour: A paid Jungle Scout API wrapper: keys as a key-name:key Authorization header; keyword and ASIN keyword queries return search-volume estimates. Errors are mapped 401/403 (check key), 422 (bad parameters), 429 (wait), other.
rows.failure_semantics: 429 is reported as a fixed message; Retry-After is not read; no retry
rows.ecdev_today: No paid keyword-volume source. Demand is an unknown on every result.
rows.knowledge: Paid keyword volume (here and in Semrush phrase reports) is the labelled demand ECDEV could test its zero-paid hypotheses against: for a set of hypothesis phrases, does social recurrence rank them like search volume does? Answerable with a few dozen paid lookups; blocked on credentials and a spend decision.
rows.oracle_or_benchmark: answerable with a paid key; not run
